scope: Real controllers in controlled DOM; verdicts deliberately prepared, not original-game evidence

checks.name: An emitted verdict cannot reopen a finisher or credit a second conclusion
All 52 stages are selectable without adding actor or campaign state
A validated shared scenario restores identity, sequence, stage and exact tick
Unknown stage/state and noninteger time fall back safely
Sharing includes only allowed presentation fields, never health or external paths
Empty search hides the scenario instead of sharing a removed subject
Invalid finisher indices never silently choose the first conclusion
Double openings preserve the existing countdown and cannot interrupt an active conclusion
Already delivered main result rejects both direct and public conclusion entry points
